# hype4.academy

> > A vibrant design education community offering video courses, design challenges, and mentorship for mastering UI, web, mobile, and graphic design.

hype4.academy (formerly SquarePlanet) is a comprehensive design learning platform founded by industry experts like Michal Malewicz and Adam Moučka. It combines structured video courses with hands-on challenges, portfolio building, and community mentorship to help designers develop professional skills across multiple disciplines.

## Key Topics

- UI Design
- Web Design
- Mobile Design
- Figma
- Design Fundamentals
- Video Courses
- Design Challenges
- Portfolio Building
- Graphic Design
- Freelancing
- Design Systems
- High-Fidelity Design
- SaaS Design
- Landing Pages
- Design Community

## Core Platform

- [Home](https://hype4.academy): SquarePlanet homepage: design community for UX, UI, and graphic design learning
- [Video Courses](https://hype4.academy/video-courses): Video courses catalog covering UI, web, mobile, and freelancing design
- [Designs](https://hype4.academy/designs): Design gallery and portfolio showcase for mobile, web, and graphic design
- [Challenges](https://hype4.academy/challenges): Design challenges platform for skill-building in mobile, web, and graphic design
- [Learn](https://hype4.academy/learn): Design learning hub with tips, articles, and bite-size educational content

## Video Courses

- [Boring UI Course](https://hype4.academy/video-courses/boring-ui-course): UI design course covering fundamentals, Figma, and design systems
- [UI in Mobile Apps](https://hype4.academy/video-courses/mobile-ui-1): Mobile UI design course teaching high-fidelity app design in Figma
- [High Fidelity](https://hype4.academy/video-courses/mobile-ui-2): Advanced mobile UI course on high-fidelity design techniques and visual quality
- [Web Design Course 1 - SaaS Product](https://hype4.academy/video-courses/web-design-course): Web design course focused on SaaS product and dashboard design
- [Web Design Course 2 - Landing Pages](https://hype4.academy/video-courses/web-design-course-2-landing-pages): Web design course teaching landing page design and typography techniques
- [How to Master Freelancing](https://hype4.academy/video-courses/master-freelancing): Freelancing course covering client acquisition, rates, and business growth

## Community & Membership

- [Plans](https://hype4.academy/plans): Pricing plans and membership tiers for SquarePlanet design academy
- [Mentors](https://hype4.academy/mentors): Mentor program connecting designers for skill development and growth
- [Partners](https://hype4.academy/partners): Design tool partners including Icons8, Lunacy, and illustration resources
- [Sponsors](https://hype4.academy/sponsors): Sponsorship and partner information for SquarePlanet design community

## Support & Information
